messages:
anna: Quick sync: we need a compact launch copy kit for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages + social + webinar. Requirements: 2 hero options per mode, 3 CTAs per mode, one tweet-sized benchmark line, webinar landing blurb, and mode-specific demo routes for lead routing. Deadline: next Wed EOD. Link: https://tiny.redwood/launch-kit-v3
ben: I’ll take hero variants and CTAs. Keep tone practical and engineer-friendly. Two headline options each; one short subhead each.
kevin: I’ll do the benchmark blurb + 2 proof bullets per page (latency, cost or SLA). Engineering to confirm numbers. Proposed social blurb: "95th-pct <120ms • up to 3x token savings in our tests" — shorten if needed.
sara: I’ll draft webinar landing + three email subject lines. Thinking workshop format: "Production inference patterns: hosted, reserved, private". Proposed date: 2026-08-11 10:00 PT. deploy-bot: webinar placeholder created for 2026-08-11 10:00 PT. Reminders set 7d and 1d prior.
nora: Routing: create three demo slugs: /demo-hosted, /demo-dedicated, /demo-private. Form fields: deployment, monthly tokens, company size, contact urgency. Sales queues: hosted -> trial queue; dedicated/private -> enterprise queue. Will add utm_campaign=tri-launch to all links.
ben: Quick hero drafts (short): Hosted A) "Hosted API: inference in minutes" B) "Start hosted inference—fast, pay-as-you-go" Subhead: "Try the hosted API, scale with predictable latency."
ben: Dedicated A) "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput" B) "Dedicated capacity with SLA-backed performance" Subhead: "Commit to capacity and maintain latency SLOs under load."
ben: Private A) "Private deployments: VPC or on-prem" B) "Bring Redwood behind your firewall" Subhead: "Customer-managed networking, KMS/HSM support, on-prem options."
kevin: CTA packs (short): Hosted: ["Start hosted trial", "Try hosted API", "Run hosted test"] Dedicated: ["Reserve capacity", "Book capacity demo", "Get SLA details"] Private: ["Request private demo", "Schedule on-prem demo", "Talk to enterprise"]
sara: Webinar subject lines (A/B/C): A) "Cut inference costs without giving up latency" B) "How teams scale predictable LLM inference" C) "Workshop: production patterns for inference" Landing hero: "Live workshop: cost, latency, and deployment patterns for production inference." CTA: "Save my seat"
kevin: Proposed tweet-sized benchmark variants: 1) "95th-pct <120ms • 3x token savings vs baseline (internal tests)" 2) "<120ms (95th) • up to 3x token cost reduction in our benchmarks" — engineering to confirm exact phrasing.
anna: (typo) :sweat_smile:
anna: small note: Private hero should stay non-technical; put KMS/HSM detail in the body and product docs.
ora: On routing: will expose a hidden 'mode' field in the form so CRM rules auto-assign queues. Also will append utm_term=ctaA/ctaB for experiments. Spreadsheet with mappings coming in an hour.
ben: For homepage use, prefer Hosted hero B, Dedicated A, Private B. Agree?
kevin: Works for me. Engineering: pls confirm benchmark numbers by Mon EOD so we can publish social. Security: pls review Private copy Wed AM for HSM/KMS wording.
sara: I'll draft email sequences and social copy with mode-specific CTAs linking to the three demo slugs (+UTMs).
anna: Assignments: ben = heroes + CTAs; kevin = benchmark + bullets; sara = webinar + posts; nora = demo routes + tracking; anna = overall editorial sign-off. Deliver drafts Tue EOD.
deploy-bot: Reminder: sync review scheduled 2026-08-04 09:00 PT.
anna: Thanks team — short and iterative. Keep messages concise. We'll iterate Tue morning after drafts. :rocket:
